text:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — Meridian Health onboarding kickoff next Wed. Need to lock the SLA/SLO details we agreed in the contract: 99.9% monthly uptime and p95 inference latency <250ms for the hosted API. Who will own the monthly SLO report and the credits calculation?

Marco (CS Ops): I can take ownership of the report and automation. Quick Q: do we use UTC month windows or customer local? Contract says monthly, but our metrics pipeline shards by region. @Lena any constraints?

Lena (Support Eng): We export prometheus aggregates to S3 daily. Uptime is derived from service.health_check_success ratio; latency p95 from inference_latency_ms histogram. Example query I run for uptime: 
```
SELECT 100 * sum(case when status='ok' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) as uptime_pct
FROM service_checks
WHERE service = 'hosted-api' AND ts >= :start AND ts < :end;
```
I can parameterize by customer tag and model. CSV output is straightforward.

Devon (Account Exec): Customer wants a 1-page SLO summary + clear credits table if we miss. Also want the monthly report emailed to their technical ops contact and cc'd to procurement. Can the report include per-model p95?

Marco (CS Ops): Yes, we'll include per-model p95 and a short incident log for the month. Plan: automated monthly SLO email + a quarterly review deck. Draft owners and timeline below.

Aisha (CSM): Two product asks: 1) define exact metric queries used for public-facing reports (so we don't get challenged), and 2) a credits calculator sheet we can share. Also flagging renewal risk if there are two consecutive months below p95.

Lena (Support Eng): For the credits calc, contract uses prorated monthly uptime below 99.9%. I'll attach a calc sheet in the onboarding docs. Formula (simplified): credits_pct = min(1, (99.9 - measured_uptime) / 99.9). We can produce line items for token counts and cost impact.

SLA Bot: Incident #2023-404 created — Degraded latency observed 2023-11-14 03:12 UTC. Ticket id: INC-2023-404.

Marco (CS Ops): Action items I'm tracking: 1) produce report template (CSV + PDF summary) 2) automation script to run queries and generate report 3) credits calculator sheet 4) customer-facing FAQ excerpt for SLOs.

Devon (Account Exec): I'll draft the one-pager customer email and the slide for renewal review. Need the report template by this Friday so I can preview.

Aisha (CSM): Owners: Marco -> report + automation; Lena -> metric queries + calc sheet; Devon -> comms + template. Target: draft by Fri (2334123670). I'll schedule a 30-min sync Thurs to walk through the draft. :calendar:

Marco (CS Ops): Also request: quick sanity check from eng-runtime on the exact histogram buckets and any sampling that may bias p95. @eng-runtime can someone review the queries when I post them?

eng-runtime: I'll review. Two things to call out — (1) tail latency can be influenced by bursty long-context requests, (2) quantized model variants may change p95 numbers; include model variant tag in the export.

Aisha (CSM): Great — thanks everyone. I'll collect the deliverables in the onboarding folder and ping Meridian's ops once we have the draft. :thumbsup:
